raw_blocks: UFP Technologies is the trusted design, development, engineering, and manufacturing partner to turn your vision into a reality through best-in-class comprehensive solutions primarily for medical devices and sterile packaging, as well as other highly engineered custom products.

MedTech evolves at breathtaking speeds. To keep pace, you need forward-thinking collaboration to develop your idea and anticipate the challenges at each phase of the process. UFP MedTech is the ideal partner to help you accelerate single-use and single patient devices from development through launch and manufacturing.

For aerospace, defense, automotive, and other highly engineered components and packaging, our advanced engineering capabilities and materials expertise ensures optimal designs and seamless implementation to make your vision a reality.
Design & Development through Manufacturing

Trust UFP Technologies to turn your vision into reality with best-in-class comprehensive solutions based on our vast depth of engineering expertise. Our nimble and dynamic team will work with you to create custom designs from foams, films, plastics, nonwovens, fabrics, and other specialty materials. All with the ultimate goal of positioning your ideas for success.
From the initial stages of development, we review your project from every angle, assigning a dedicated team to fully understand the unique needs and potential challenges before we start.
We act as an extension of your R&D and engineering teams, applying our vast materials expertise and design skills, so that each decision we make is optimized for the application.

We understand the importance of delivering sound engineering and rapid prototypes. Our in-house tooling capabilities and custom equipment allow us to execute quickly and accurately, producing prototypes within 72 hours.
Mitigating any potential risks through quality management systems ensures a seamless transition from prototype to full-scale production.
Our turnkey solutions include high volume manufacturing, packaging, and supply chain management through multiple global locations to get your product to market quickly and efficiently.
It's great to be here!
If you’re looking for a professional, energetic, family-oriented work environment that fosters professional development and career advancement, you’re ready for UFP.

raw_blocks: We strive to be our customers’ design, engineering and manufacturing partner, entrusted to turn their vision into reality through best-in-class comprehensive solutions for medical devices, packaging, components and products.

Founded in 1963 and headquartered in Newburyport, Massachusetts, UFP Technologies is a contract development and manufacturing organization that specializes in single-use and single-patient medical devices. UFP is an important link in the medical device supply chain and a valued outsource partner to many of the top medical device manufacturers in the world. Our single-use and single-patient devices and components are used in a wide range of medical devices and packaging for minimally invasive surgery, infection prevention, wound care, wearables, orthopedic soft goods, and orthopedic implants.
We are your one-stop solution for:

Mr. Bailly serves as the Executive Chairman of the Board, as of June 2026 after retiring as Chief Executive Officer of UFP Technologies since 1995. Mr. Bailly joined the Company in 1988 and served as a Division Manager (1989-1992), General Manager Northeast Operations (1992-1994), Vice President of Operations (1994-1995), and as its President (1995-2024). From 1984 through 1988, Mr. Bailly, a certified public accountant, was employed by Coopers & Lybrand. Mr. Bailly is a member of World Presidents’ Organization.
President and Chief Executive Officer

Mr. Rock initially joined UFP Technologies in 1991 and served as Director of Sales and Marketing for the company’s Molded Fiber division. From May 1999 through October 2000, Mr. Rock served as Vice President of Sales and Business Development at Esprocket, an internet start-up company. Mr. Rock rejoined UFP in April 2001 as Vice President of Sales and Marketing for the company’s Molded Fiber division and later served as Vice President of Sales and Marketing for the entire company from May 2002 to June 2014. In June 2014, Mr. Rock was promoted to Senior Vice President of Sales and Marketing. In January 2020, he was named General Manager, Medical, and in June 2021, the Board of Directors appointed him President of MedTech. In February 2024, Mr. Rock was appointed President of the company, and was appointed CEO in June 2026. Since 2016, he has also served on the board of directors of Outlook Amusements, Inc., an entertainment company specializing in advice-based products and services.
Senior Vice President, Treasurer and Chief Financial Officer

Mr. Lataille joined UFP Technologies in November 1997 as its Chief Financial Officer. Prior to joining the company, Mr. Lataille served as Vice President, Treasurer and Chief Financial Officer of Little Switzerland, Inc., from 1991 through October 1997. He also served as interim President and Chief Executive Officer of Little Switzerland from October 1994 through October 1995. From 1984 to 1991, Mr. Lataille, a certified public accountant, was employed by Coopers & Lybrand.
Senior Vice President, Human Resources, General Counsel and Secretary

Mr. Stafford joined UFP Technologies in June 2026. Most recently, Mr. Stafford served as Executive Vice President, Chief Legal Officer, and Corporate Secretary at Littelfuse, a global, publicly traded technology company. In that role, he oversaw the company’s global legal function, corporate governance, mergers and acquisitions, and enterprise-wide sustainability and compliance programs. Earlier in his career, Mr. Stafford spent nearly a decade with Tyco International, where he held several senior leadership roles, including General Counsel for a $6.5B global business serving operations in more than 100 countries, as well as Vice President of China Operations, where he helped build integrated shared services across finance, IT, and HR.

Mr. Holt joined UFP Technologies in 2018 as General Manager of our Advanced Components business. In June of 2021, he was appointed Vice President by the Board of Directors. In February of 2024, he was promoted to Chief Commercial Officer of the company, and in February of 2026, he was promoted to Senior Vice President. From 2004-2018, Mr. Holt held a number of leadership positions at a Fortune 200 company, Illinois Tool Works, where he ultimately became Vice President and General Manager of a $100+ million business unit.

Mr. Croteau has served as one of our directors since December 2015. Presently, Mr. Croteau serves as Chief Executive Officer of Viant Medical, a global provider of medical technology solutions. He is also a member of the Board of Directors of Corza Medical, a private equity-backed company that specializes in high performance wound closure products, biosurgical products and ophthalmic instrumentation. Mr. Croteau served as the CEO of Corza Medical from January of 2021 to January of 2023, when he retired. His prior company, Surgical Specialties Corporation, was acquired in January 2021 and was simultaneously combined with the Tachosil Business from Takeda Pharmaceuticals to form Corza Medical. Mr. Croteau was the Chief Executive Officer of Vention Medical from January 2011 until March 2017, when he resigned in connection with the acquisition of Vention Medical by Nordson Corporation and the divestiture of the Vention Device Manufacturing Services business unit to MedPlast Inc. Vention Medical provides component manufacturing, assembly and design services for disposable medical devices, with fourteen facilities across the United States, Central America, Ireland, and Israel. Prior to assuming his role with Vention Medical, Mr. Croteau was President of FlexMedical from July 2005 through December 2010. FlexMedical is the medical division of Flex (Nasdaq: FLEX), which provides manufacturing and supply chain services for disposable medical devices, medical equipment, and drug delivery devices. From July 2004 to June 2005, Mr. Croteau served as the Executive Vice President and General Manager of Orthopedics for Accellent (renamed Lake Region Medical in 2014 and now a division of Integer), a manufacturer of specialty components and finished medical devices used in orthopedic, cardiology, and surgical devices. From August 1999 to June 2004, Mr. Croteau served as an executive at MedSource Technologies, which was merged in June 2004 with UTI Corporation to form Accellent. As Senior Vice President at MedSource Technologies, Mr. Croteau was responsible for sales, marketing, strategy and acquisitions. Prior to entering the medical device industry in 1999, Mr. Croteau spent the majority of his career in various roles at General Electric and working as a consultant for Booz & Company in Sydney, Australia. Mr. Croteau has a Bachelor of Science degree in mechanical engineering from the University of Vermont and a Master of Business Administration from Harvard Business School. Since May 2019, Mr. Croteau has served on the board of directors of Resonetics, a privately held laser manufacturing services company providing micro components to global medical device companies. From October 2014 to March 2018 and from July 2020 to present, Mr. Croteau also served as a member of the board of directors of Inventus Power, a privately held, global manufacturer of custom battery packs, chargers, and portable power supply systems. Since December 2024, Mr. Croteau has served on the board of directors of Zeus Inc., a leading provider of tubing, catheter componentry, heat shrinks, bioabsorbable and implantable medical products, sutures, fiber optics coatings to medical and aerospace markets.

Ms. Feldmann has served as one of our directors since June 2017. From 2022 until 2025, Ms. Feldmann served on the board of Alexandria Real Estate Equities, Inc. (NYSE: ARE), an urban office real estate investing trust focused on collaborative life science, agtech and technology campuses in AAA innovation cluster locations. She served on the Alexandria board’s Science and Technology Committee. Ms. Feldmann served on the board of Frequency Therapeutics, Inc. (Nasdaq: FREQ), a clinical-stage biotechnology company focused on harnessing the body’s innate biology to repair or reverse damage caused by a broad range of degenerative diseases, where she also chaired the Frequency Audit Committee from September 2020 until November 2023 when Frequency was combined with Korro Bio (Nasdaq: KRRO) in a reverse merger. Since 2005, Ms. Feldmann has served on the board of directors of STERIS PLC (NYSE: STE), a provider of infection prevention, decontamination, and health science technologies, products and services. She chairs the STERIS Nominating & Governance Committee and previously chaired and is a current member of the Audit Committee. She also previously served as a member of the STERIS Compliance and Technology Committee. From 2013 to 2023 Ms. Feldmann served on the board of trustees and was a member and previously chaired the Finance Committee of Falmouth Academy, an academically rigorous, co-ed college preparatory day school for grades 7 to 12. Ms. Feldmann continues to serve as a Board Member Emeritus at Falmouth Academy. Cynthia previously served on the publicly traded company Boards of Hanger Inc., Heartware International, Inc., and Hayes-Lemmerz. Previously, Ms. Feldmann had a 27-year career in public accounting; she was Partner at KPMG LLP, holding various leadership roles in the firm’s Medical Technology and Health Care & Life Sciences industry groups and was National Partnerin-Charge of the Life Sciences practice for Coopers & Lybrand (now PricewaterhouseCoopers LLP), among other leadership positions she held during her career there. Ms. Feldmann was a founding board member of Mass Medic, a Massachusetts trade association for medical technology companies, where she also served as treasurer and as a member of the board's Executive Committee during her tenure from 1997 to 2001. Ms. Feldmann is a retired CPA.

Mr. Hassett has served as one of our directors since June 2022. Mr. Hassett was Senior Vice President and Chief Transformation Officer for Analog Devices Inc, (“ADI”) up to his retirement in November 2024, prior to that he was Senior Vice President and Chief Operating Officer for the Maxim Business since August 2021 where he led ADI’s strategic and operational focus to integrate Maxim Inc., a $2.5 billion business acquired by ADI in August 2021. He also serves on Deloitte Semiconductor sector Advisory Board. Mr. Hassett brings extensive experience as a business leader, having run ADI’s largest revenue-generating business, operational expertise leveraging his previous Global Operations & Technology leadership, in addition to his various engineering management roles with ADI. Previously, Mr. Hassett was Senior Vice President, Corporate Integration Management where he led significant efforts in M&A transactions and was responsible for developing strategies that drove the integration of multi-billion-dollar transactions from due diligence to fully integrated entities from December 2020 to July 2021. Previously, Mr. Hassett was Senior Vice President of Industrial and Consumer Group from November 2019 to December 2020 where he led growth initiatives that leveraged its extensive franchise capability in measurement, sensing, and testing. He was Senior Vice President of Global Operations & Technology from May 2015 to November 2019, where he was instrumental in setting and executing our manufacturing strategy and creating a world-class, scalable supply chain to deliver outstanding quality for our customers. Mr. Hassett joined ADI in 1982 after graduating from the University of Limerick where he earned a Bachelor of Science degree in Manufacturing Engineering. Mr. Hassett also holds a Master of Business Administration from the University of Limerick.

Mr. Kozin has served as one of our directors since 2006. Mr. Kozin served as President of L.E.K. Consulting from 1997 through 2011 and as a Senior Advisor from 2011 through 2018. In December 2022, Mr. Kozin transitioned to the Board of Healthcare Royalty Holdings from that company’s Strategy Advisory Board where he had been serving as chairperson since January 2013. Previously, Mr. Kozin served on the boards of directors of Endocyte (sold to Novartis), Dyax (sold to Shire), Dicerna (sold to Novo Nordisk), Chimerix (sold to Jazz), Frequency Therapeutics (merged with Korro), Flex Pharma (merged with Salarius), VBL Therapeutics (merged with Notable), OvaScience (merged with Millendo), Crunchtime! Information Systems, Medical Simulation Corporation, Brandwise, Advizex, Lynx Therapeutics, Inc., Assurance Medical, Inc., and Isleworth Healthcare Acquisition Corporation.

Ms. Hudson has served as one of our directors since June 2022. Presently, Ms. Hudson is the President and CEO of United Way Miami. Prior to the United Way Miami role, she served as CEO of Chapman Partnership from November 2018 through July 2022. Since August 2018, Ms. Hudson has served as an Operating Advisor for Revival Healthcare Partners; as an executive Board Member and on the Governance and Audit Committee for MTF Biologics from July 2021 through December 2024; and as a Board Member for Baxter Foundation. From April 2016 to January 2018, Ms. Hudson was the President of Global Franchises and Innovation for ConvaTec, a $1.8 Billion international medical products and technologies company. From December 2013 to March 2016, Ms. Hudson served in various strategic leadership roles for Baxter, Inc., a $10.7 billion company that develops, manufactures, and markets products providing a broad portfolio of essential renal hospital products including home, acute and in-center dialysis; sterile IV solutions; and infusion systems and devices. Before joining Baxter, Ms. Hudson was the VP of Continuous Improvement & Transformation for Hospira, Inc (now Pfizer), a $4 billion world leader in specialty generic injectable pharmaceuticals, generic acute-care and oncology injectables, integrated infusion therapy devices and medication management solutions. From May 2005 to July 2013, Ms. Hudson served as General Manager of Medication Management Systems, VP of Global Marketing for On-Market Product 6 Strategies Devices, VP of Marketing – US Region Medication Management Systems, and VP of Continuous Improvement and Transformation. Between August 1999 and February 2005, Ms. Hudson served in various leadership roles for Aon Corporation, an $8 billion risk management, retail, reinsurance & wholesale brokerage, claims management, specialty services, and human capital consulting services company; and Household International, an $8 billion financial service provider of consumer loans, credit cards, auto finance, and credit insurance products in the US, UK, and Canada. Ms. Hudson holds a Master of Business Administration from Harvard Business School and a BS from Alabama A&M University. She was recognized as a Top 50 Business Leader of Color in 2015.

Mr. Oberdorf has served as one of our directors since 2004. Mr. Oberdorf was Chief Executive Officer of SIRVA, Inc., a leading global provider of moving and relocation services to corporations, consumers, and governments, from October 2017 until his retirement in January 2025. He remained employed as a Senior Advisor at SIRVA until July 2025. He was Chairman of SIRVA from August 2018 to September 2024 and was Chief Financial Officer from August 2011 to October 2017. From August 2010 through March 2011, Mr. Oberdorf consulted for Orchard Brands, a multi channel marketer of men’s and women’s apparel for the 55+ market segment. From December 2008 through August 2010, Mr. Oberdorf was Executive Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of infoGROUP, Inc., which provides business and consumer databases for sales leads and mailing lists, database marketing services, data processing services, e mail marketing, market research, and sales and marketing solutions. From June 2006 through 2008, Mr. Oberdorf was Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer, and Treasurer of Getty Images Inc., the world’s leading creator and distributor of still imagery, footage, and multi media products, as well as a recognized provider of other forms of premium digital content, including music. From March 2002 through June 2006, Mr. Oberdorf was Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer of CMGI, Inc., a supply chain management, marketing distribution and ecommerce solutions company, where he served as a consultant from November 2001 through February 2002. From February 1999 through October 2001, Mr. Oberdorf was Senior Vice President and Chief Financial Officer of Bertelsmann AG’s subsidiary, BeMusic Direct, a direct to consumer music sales company. From January 1981 through January 1999, Mr. Oberdorf served in various capacities at Readers Digest Association, Inc., most recently as Vice President Global Books & Home Entertainment— Finance.
As a trusted industry leader for over sixty years, we’ve earned more than our fair share of accolades. The following are just some of the honors we’ve been proud to receive.
It's Great to be Here!
If you’re looking for a professional, energetic, family-oriented work environment that fosters professional development and career advancement, you’re ready for UFP.
Much like our focus on shaping design and engineering innovation, UFP was forged through decades of continuous advancement. Discover the milestones that made us who we are today.
United Packaging Corporation was founded. The company supplied protective packaging for computers and electronics.
Expanded operations and relocated headquarters to Georgetown, MA.
Started precision molding cross-linked polyethylene foam.
Introduced compression molded medical protective packaging using specialized foams.
Acquired Moulded Fibre Technology, a pioneer in custom molded fiber packaging.
Completed IPO and changed name to UFP Technologies, Inc.
Invested in cleanroom production for our growing medical customer base.
Acquired FCE Industries to expand foam and plastic market reach to the Midwest.
Acquired Pacific Foam Technologies to enhance West Coast foam plastic capabilities.
Introduced TPU-based pouches and bags as an alternative to foam packaging for the orthopedic implant market.
Acquired Stephenson & Lawyer to expand polyurethane foam fabrication.
Acquired Advanced Materials Group, E.N. Murray, and Foamade Industries to expand our foam fabrication capabilities.
Acquired Packaging Alternatives Corporation to expand polyurethane foam capabilities for the medical market.
Named to The Boston Globe’s “The Globe 100” for the 8th consecutive year.
Expanded operations and relocated headquarters to Newburyport, MA.

Acquired Dielectrics, founded in 1955 and located in Chicopee MA, a leader in medical device manufacturing using thermoplastic materials as well as the innovator of the Reebok® Pump introduced in 1989.

Acquired Contech Medical, founded in 1987 and located in Providence, RI, with partner manufacturing in Costa Rica, a global leader in the development and manufacture of class III medical device packaging primarily for catheters and guidewires.

Acquired DAS Medical, located in Atlanta, GA, with manufacturing in the Dom. Rep., a medical device contract manufacturer specializing in single-use surgical equipment covers, robotic draping systems and fluid control pouches.
Acquired Advant Medical, located in Galway, Ireland, with operations in Costa Rica and partner manufacturing in Mexico, a manufacturer of Class I, II, and III medical devices and packaging.
Opened new medical manufacturing operation in Tijuana, Mexico.
Received the Kestra Medical Technologies “Execution Award” for our contributions on their ASSURE® Wearable Cardioverter Defibrillator (WCD) system.
Acquired AJR Enterprises of St. Charles, IL, with additional manufacturing in the Dom. Rep., to expand our cut and sew capabilities for patient surfaces and transfer devices.
Acquired Welch Fluorocarbon of Dover, NH, a manufacturer of thermoformed, and heat sealed implantable medical device components utilizing thin, high-performance films.
Received the Freudenberg Home and Cleaning Solutions (FHCS) “Global Quality System Triangle Award.”
Acquired Marble Medical of Tallahassee, FL, a manufacturer of adhesive based medical components and single-use devices.

Acquired AQF Medical of Navan, Ireland, with joint venture operations in Singapore, a manufacturer of custom-engineered foam and thermoplastic components used in a wide range of medical devices and packaging.
Acquired sister companies of AJR Enterprise: AJR Specialty Products and AJR Custom Foam Products of St. Charles, IL, to expand our cut and sew capabilities for patient surfaces and transfer devices.

Acquired Universal Plastics & Engineering Company (UNIPEC) of Rockville, MD, a manufacturer of precision thermoformed and heat-sealed polymer components used primarily for shielding batteries in Class III implantable medical devices.
Acquired Techno Plastics Industries (TPI) of Anasco, Puerto Rico, a manufacturer of precision thermoplastic injection-molded components.
Named one of the National Association for Business Resources’ “Best and Brightest Companies to Work for in the Nation” for the 7th time.

100 Hale Street Newburyport, MA 01950 USA

raw_blocks: Eliminate or reduce noise, maintain temperature and air flow, or keep valuable items protected and safe. We specialize in anticipating the challenges of product construction and packaging, providing solutions for the most unique configurations and requirements.
EXPLORE OUR RANGE OF APPLICATIONS
Customized and engineered to suit the specific needs of your project.

UFP Technologies designs, develops and manufactures best-in-class packaging solutions for a variety of industries. We source specialty materials and utilize our multiple manufacturing facilities across the country to offer numerous capabilities including compression molding, routing, die-cutting, and more.

From complex environments to streamlined solutions, we approach insulation with meticulous detail. Eliminate or reduce noise, regulate temperature and protect the form and function of your project with custom components and sound engineering.

Flow, filtration, and fluid become much easier to manage with our unique fabrications and materials expertise. Our extensive knowledge on the mercurial nature of liquid and air, enables us to create functional solutions in a vast range of configurations.

When the going gets tough, we design and develop even stronger solutions. Whether it’s the latest advancements in military gear, or ensuring the safety and comfort of our athletes, we create, test, and manufacture protection that lasts.

We shift our expertise into overdrive when designing, developing and manufacturing custom, cost-effective trim and structural components for the automotive industry. Using various foams and specialty materials, our lightweight solutions are made to reduce noise and vibration in the cabin, while meeting the specific design requirements of each vehicle.
See how UFP Technologies uses over 60 years of manufacturing experience to turn your vision into a reality.
